evidence: Clear four-layer package separation: controller, service, repository, model
MVC pattern: Spring MVC controllers + Thymeleaf view templates + JPA model entities
No service discovery (no Eureka, Consul, or Kubernetes manifests)
No API gateway (no Zuul, Spring Cloud Gateway, or similar)
No message brokers (no Kafka, RabbitMQ, or JMS in pom.xml or configuration)
docker-compose defines two services (app + Oracle DB), not a microservices split
values: Three-tier: Presentation / Business Logic / Data Access
